name: ultrapolish
description: Two universal design-polish skills that take any app from 6/10 to 11/10 on attention to detail, UX and cohesion, inside its own visual style. ultrapolish-ios for Swift/SwiftUI, ultrapolish-web for React/TypeScript/CSS. Motion, colour, typography, layout, sheets, haptics, sound, buttons, icons, copy, states, onboarding, paywalls, widgets, accessibility. Reads your existing tokens first and never introduces a palette, a typeface, or a motion personality. Invoke as ultrapolish:ultrapolish-ios or ultrapolish:ultrapolish-web.
